Card Q&A.a: Yes, you can. This effect reads "may digivolve into [WarGreymon] in your hand," therefore you can choose to not digivolve after placing [Greymon] and [MetalGreymon] from your trash under [Agumon].
Card Q&A.q: Can I use this card to place 1 [Greymon] and 1 [MetalGreymon] from my trash under [Agumon] but choose to not digivolve into [WarGreymon] in my hand?

Effect: While you have a Tamer with [Tai Kamiya] in its name, you may ignore this card's color requirements.

[Main] By placing 1 [Greymon] and 1 [MetalGreymon] from your trash as 1 of your [Agumon]'s bottom digivolution cards, that Digimon may digivolve into [WarGreymon] in your hand without paying the cost, ignoring its digivolution requirements.
Security Effect: [Security] You may play 1 [Agumon] from your hand or trash without paying the cost. Then, add this card to the hand.
